scalars.scalar_value: Five (5) years experience working in healthcare Rev Cycle or a Professional Medical Office

items.item_text: Five (5) years experience working in healthcare Rev Cycle or a Professional Medical Office
One (1) year experience with IDX Practice management system
One (1) year experience with Cerner EHR

Demonstrates a solid understanding of accounts receivable and your role as the A/R Billing Rep Lead to include: Payor Rules & Regulations; Understand Contract Language; CCI Coding Issues; Read and interpret DOFR; Comprehend how transaction affect account; Coordination of Benefits Rules; Offsets & Recoups; Ability to determine correct systems to locate pertinent info; IDX, Medical Records Systems, Insurance Payor Websites, Code Correct.
Provide in-depth analysis of inventory to identify possible system issues, payer denial trends and areas for staff training development.

Independently researches and analyzes complex issues/accounts with available resources and tools. This may include direct contact with payor to determine if staff actions(s) taken are in compliance with current workflows and policies.
Maintains, tracks and compiles audit scores within the expected turn around time.
Works directly with A/R Billing Supervisor to ensure compliance with billing regulations on all discrepancies identified in an audit.
Must be able to use a high level of judgment, initiative, and resourcefulness when dealing with internal and external customers
Associates or Other in Healthcare Administration or related field
Understanding of professional claims and billing procedures. Knowledge of Federal and State regulations applicable to Government and Insurance Collections
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Demonstrated ability to provide leadership to others
Working knowledge of computers and demonstrated proficiency in using Email systems, Internet and MS office software applications with emphasis in Word and Excel
Strong MS Excel skills to interpret and analyze high volume of data
